item.title: Three Fatal Shootings, Power Restoration, Manny Fresh
item.ns0:title: Three Fatal Shootings, Power Restoration, Manny Fresh
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, a wave of violence grips the capital as police launch three separate investigations into fatal shootings across New Providence within a 24-hour span. We bring you a glimmer of hope for frustrated Grand Key residents awaiting a breakthrough in their weeks-long power struggle, while the political opposition demands immediate transparency over the transfer of millions from the National Investment Fund. Plus, we highlight local summer initiatives training young Bahamian entrepreneurs and engineers, and capture the unforgettable moment a legendary hip-hop producer remixed a Bahamian anthem on a local stage. Catch up on all these developments and get your complete weekend sports and weather outlook by tuning in to tonight's full broadcast.
